concurrency: Pure value import from immutable serialized input; no shared mutable state and no connection to a live producer.
inputs: versioned observation projection envelope and records
outputs: rejection diagnostics for incomplete/unknown projection input
purpose: Consume a documented, versioned serialized projection of owned C++ X-COM ObservationRecord values, map every accessor by value, hold no callback/hub/provider/delivery authority, and reject the narrower gateway schema as the full projection unless a separate versioned mapping records each missing field as unavailable.
state: Owns only copied immutable record values inside the run evidence; owns no hub, tap, provider handle, callback or delivery state.

static_checks.expected: ast.parse succeeds for every planned path; the projection mapping is closed and no socket/subprocess/hub/tap/provider reference exists
static_checks.rule: python ast parse of the planned observation source plus a check that the accessor mapping is a closed field set and that no socket, subprocess, hub, tap or provider handle is referenced
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-008-U unit specification - X-COM owned observation projection import

unit_cases.expected: every mapped accessor value (contract/interface/endpoint/schema ids and versions, interaction, origin, clocks, sequence, correlations, route/provider, source payload size, provider outcome, payload view/schema state, visible bytes, tap id, counters) is preserved by value
unit_cases.precondition: a versioned projection serialized by the real owned C++ producer fixture over accepted X-COM headers

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-PROJECTION-INCOMPLETE; no record is appended
rejected; ARGUS2-SCHEMA-MAJOR-UNSUPPORTED; no record is appended
unit_cases.precondition: a projection whose projectionVersion major is not 1

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-PROJECTION-INCOMPLETE, unless an explicitly versioned separate mapping records each missing field as unavailable; missing metadata is never fabricated
unit_cases.precondition: a gateway-shaped observation record carrying only the narrower protobuf field set

unit_cases.expected: no callback, mutable hub handle, provider handle, tap handle or delivery method is reachable; import only copies immutable values
unit_cases.stimulus: inspect the run object and module surface

unit_cases.expected: the provider outcome is stored verbatim and does not by itself change evidenceStatus or create any experiment-validity claim
rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-PAYLOAD-LENGTH; bytes are never synthesized, padded or truncated to fit
unit_cases.precondition: a projection whose visibleBytesHex decodes to a byte count other than visibleByteCount

unit_cases.expected: rejected with the ARGUS2-SCHEMA-UNKNOWN-FIELD class; this slice never claims decoder success
rejected; ARGUS2-SCHEMA-UNKNOWN-FIELD; the unknown key is neither ignored nor silently discarded
unit_cases.precondition: a projection record carrying an additional nested key outside extensions

unit_cases.expected: rejected; ARGUS2-INPUT-IDENTITY-MISSING; no partial accepted record is retained
unit_cases.precondition: a projection record with no contractId or schemaId

unit_cases.expected: import succeeds without any socket, network, subprocess or live tap attach/pull/acknowledge operation
unit_cases.precondition: an import performed with socket/subprocess access made unavailable

unit_cases.expected: the reconstructed record values equal the projected values exactly; no field is defaulted, reordered or normalized
unit_cases.precondition: a frozen owned projection imported and exported once
